title: docs(data-modeling): an OData datasources guide, and the three-way choice between declarative OData, a plugin driver and a synced real object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiKpjJFk37ZN4qtHqsLTEJcU)_

Fixes #27747

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新增指南页「OData datasources」：用 OData v4 声明式接入 SAP S/4HANA、Dynamics 365 的完整示例（挂插件、声明数据源、绑定实体集、`credentialsRef` 认证、下推与兜底、写入门槛、失败时调用方看到什么）。「Virtual objects」页开头改为三选一规则：慢变参考数据用真表加定时同步，有 OData v4 用声明式 OData，没有 OData、按需计算或私有 API 才写插件驱动；并注明 Salesforce 不对外提供自身数据的 OData，需要自己的驱动。
- **为什么改：** epic #27261 P2：驱动 #27741 已落地，但没有一页文档说明怎么用它、何时该用它。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改文档和 driver-odata 的 README（附一个 patch changeset），不改任何代码与 schema；回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `content/docs/data-modeling/odata-datasources.mdx`；`virtual-objects.mdx` 的「Which way in」一节。
- **需要您做的：** 无。另有一处发现见下方 Acceptance notes：`os serve` 不把自己的密钥存储交给 stack 里的插件，OData 插件在 `os serve` 下只能用宿主自带的 `resolve`。

## What changes

- **New page `content/docs/data-modeling/odata-datasources.mdx`** (nav: after External datasources). Sections: check the service (v4 only, a key per entity set, the auth it takes); mount `createODataDriverPlugin` in the stack's `plugins` with its option table; declare the datasource and bind objects (an `os:check` example: `schemaMode: 'external'`, `driver` equal to the plugin name, `remoteName` as the entity set, `columnMap`, `id` as the entity key, lazy `$metadata`, `checkOnBoot: false`); credentials through `external.credentialsRef` only (bearer, basic, none; resolved at the first request and again after a 401; fail-closed; what `secrets` must be on a composed kernel and on `os serve`); what the service is asked behind the engine floor (`$filter` operators, what is left to the engine, the never-narrower rule, `$orderby` with the key, `@odata.nextLink` paging, the 1000-row cap); writes (double opt-in, POST / PATCH / DELETE by key, `If-Match`, refusal mapping, what is refused by name) and the sharing-model choice; the failure table; what the driver does not do.
- **`virtual-objects.mdx`:** "Virtual, or a real object?" becomes "Which way in: OData, a plugin driver, or a real object", opening with the card's three rules in order (slow-changing reference data, then OData v4, then a plugin driver) above the existing copy-or-not table. A paragraph says Salesforce publishes no OData service for its own records, so it takes a plugin driver over its REST API. The SAP sales-orders example points to the OData page when the ERP publishes OData v4, and See also links it.
- **`external-datasources.mdx`:** the opening callout and See also route OData v4 services to the new page.
- **`meta.json`, `index.mdx` and `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`:** list the new page (the nav, the module index block, and the hand-written docs audit scope, regenerated with `check-audit-scope.mjs --write`).
- **`packages/drivers/driver-odata/README.md`:** one cross-link to the guide, with a `patch` changeset (`.changeset/27747-odata-guide-readme-link.md`), since the README ships in the package.

## Why

Epic #27261 P2 (ruling 6486145005, Tier B = declarative OData; 田騏 2026-10-29T21:58Z 「现在启动全部 P2」). #27741 shipped the driver (PR #27796, `0a4b0fb2`); no guide page showed an OData datasource or said when to choose declarative OData, a plugin driver, or a synced real object.

## Verification

- **The examples parse against `main`'s schema.** The `os:check` block run through `defineStack` from `packages/spec/src` with `tsx`: it parses (one datasource, one object, `external` kept as written). The plugin options in the mount example run through `parseODataDriverConfig`: accepted. The four refusals the page names (credentials in `serviceRoot`, a query string, `version: '2.0'`, an unknown key) are each refused with the message the page describes.
- **Every claim was read off the driver's source and tests** at `0a4b0fb2`: `config.ts`, `plugin.ts`, `transport.ts` (401 re-resolve, same-origin links, `Prefer: odata.maxpagesize`), `filter.ts` (the pushdown list and the never-narrower rules), `odata-driver.ts` (key as `id`, `columnMap` both ways, lazy `$metadata`, writes and refusals), and the floor and conformance tests. The `os serve` statement was read off `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the binder is built inline and passed only to `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin`) and `service-datasource` (no service exposes it).
- **Local gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 88 families from the changed files (71 before the changeset, index row and audit-scope row were added); every one was run, exit codes recorded before any pipe. First pass: `check-section-landing-index` and `check:docs-audit-scope` red on the new page (the module index row and `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`), both fixed; `check:skill-examples` (which type-checks the page's `os:check` block), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 until the packages were built. Final pass, after building `./packages/**`: `dispatch-gates --ran`: "88 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". `origin/main` merged at `c62ec8e2` (none of the 12 incoming commits touched these files); `check:doc-anchors`, `check-section-landing-index` and `check:docs-audit-scope` re-run green on the merged head. The full battery is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding: `os serve` gives a stack's OData plugin no way to reach its secret store.** `os serve` builds its `sys_secret` binder inline (`serve.ts`) and passes it only to `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin`; no kernel service exposes it. So under `os serve`, `createODataDriverPlugin({ secrets })` cannot be handed the binder that resolves a `sys_secret:` handle, and the page tells the reader to pass a `resolve` backed by the host's own secret handling. Reported to the epic PM to decide whether it is a card (and whether #27746's credential seam covers it); this PR documents what the runtime does today.
- **Left out on purpose, per the Claim:** the `external.connector` mention (#27786's), and the pointer to #27744's conformance kit (#27798 is not on `main`; the epic PM moves it to #27786 if it lands after this PR is ready).
- **Not covered by tests, and the page says so:** the boot-time drift check (`checkOnBoot: true`) over an OData service.
- **Worktree name:** the Claim names `objectstack-issue-27747`; the worktree is `objectstack-27747` on the claimed branch.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; no source file changed (`pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own Chinese reader section).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
